honestly I've found this discourse super validating. 

if there was a legible answer, I'd know it by now! instead I am far afield in increasingly off-the-beaten-path styles of non-massage bodywork

that are somehow still more legible. by working with fascia, the nervous system, vascular system / nerves etc. but much of that doesn't look like massage anymore :P 

some of it still does, but I'm about 50-50 "massage" and non-massage bodywork in my sessions nowadays
